release: ADMINISTRATOR MIRROR · MATH CORE GRID BACKGROUND LOCK

global_versioning.rule: The application build is global. Classic/Market engine versions are component references, not the Administrator application version.

windows: Atlas Math Core / Math Core Métaux
operator_compositions: Target Top + Market Flow + Market + Math Core
Any subset can be reduced, hidden, detached or restored without stopping its business runtime.

window_contract.docked: native Classic/Mirror layout; exactly one persistent window handle per operational unit
window_contract.window_handle: five direct compact controls: ⠿ move, — reduce, □ detach/dock, ⤢ maximize/restore, × hide; same hit targets and hover-reveal semantics as 39.2.9
window_contract.minimize: collapse the entire operational unit to one compact visible restore bar in its native location; + Restaurer then × at the far right; runtime continues
window_contract.hide: remove the entire operational unit from cockpit; recall through WINDOW DECK; runtime continues
window_contract.detach: move/use the original DOM presentation; never clone business content
window_contract.storage_note: preserved intentionally from validated 39.2.11; 39.2.15 does not reset operator layout

math_core_contract.docked: Classic Math Core behavior preserved exactly
math_core_contract.detached: exact validated 39.2.11 detached geometry; preferred width about 42% of viewport, clamped 520-760 px
math_core_contract.native_modes: Dessus / Latéral / Réduire remain native Math Core controls
math_core_contract.administrator_chrome: validated 39.2.11 compact hover chrome pinned to the far-right lower edge
math_core_contract.administrator_background: CSS-only grid-attached visual plane on #math in native top/Dessus mode; no external backdrop node, observers or geometry changes

domain_contract.graph: same #analyste surface carries active Crypto or Métaux reading
domain_contract.target: portal host follows Crypto/Metals native ribbon container
domain_contract.flow: portal host follows Crypto/Metals native ribbon container
domain_contract.market: portal host follows Crypto/Metals native market grid
domain_contract.math: same Math Core DOM and Classic placement logic preserved

hover_chrome_contract.local_controls: 39.2.9 behavior preserved: faint at rest, reveal on parent hover, full on direct hover
hover_chrome_contract.global_dock_rest: ghost mode, intentionally much fainter than local module chrome
hover_chrome_contract.global_dock_hover: whole dock becomes clearly readable without moving or resizing
hover_chrome_contract.touch: global dock and local controls remain explicit because hover is unavailable

workspace_principle.operator_model: show only the operational surfaces needed for the task in progress
workspace_principle.composition: Graphique, Target, Flow, Market, Math Core and Administrator workspaces can be composed freely
workspace_principle.minimize_hide_runtime: visual state only; business runtime continues unless a future module exposes an explicit real suspend lifecycle
workspace_principle.business_clone: never clone business DOM/data to create a window
workspace_principle.freeze_intent: validate 39.2.15 in Firefox; if the Math Core background is correct and no neighbouring surface is affected, freeze Windows/Metal/Chrome and move to 39.3 Market Memory
